## What's free

5 free Starter clusters per organisation, each with 5 GiB row storage, 5 GiB columnar storage and 50M request units/month; MySQL-compatible

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://www.pingcap.com/tidb-cloud-pricing/> before relying on this.

## Notes

A cluster that uses up its monthly quota refuses new connections until the month resets or a spending limit is set. A sixth cluster needs a card and a spending limit.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
